text_en: Then Job answered:
text_cn: 约伯回答说：

text_en: “O that my vexation were weighed, and all my calamity laid in the balances!
text_cn: 恨不得有人衡量衡量我的痛苦，把我所受的灾祸一起放在天秤上！

text_en: For then it would be heavier than the sand of the sea; therefore my words have been rash.
text_cn: 它们重过海岸的沙粒，难怪我出言冒失。

text_en: For the arrows of the Almighty are in me; my spirit drinks their poison; the terrors of God are arrayed against me.
text_cn: 因为全能者的箭射中了我，我的心灵喝尽它们的毒汁，天主的恐吓列阵攻击我。

text_en: Does the wild ass bray over its grass, or the ox low over its fodder?
text_cn: 野驴有青草，难道还嘶叫？牛对着草料，难道还吼鸣？

text_en: Can that which is tasteless be eaten without salt, or is there any flavor in the juice of mallows?
text_cn: 淡而无盐的食物，岂能下咽？蛋白能有什么滋味？

text_en: My appetite refuses to touch them; they are like food that is loathsome to me.
text_cn: 这使我厌恶的食物，我实不愿沾唇。

text_en: “O that I might have my request, and that God would grant my desire;
text_cn: 惟愿我的祈求实现，愿天主满全我的希望！

text_en: that it would please God to crush me, that he would let loose his hand and cut me off!
text_cn: 愿天主击毁我，松手使我消灭！

text_en: This would be my consolation; I would even exult in unrelenting pain; for I have not denied the words of the Holy One.
text_cn: 这样，我仍有安慰，在凄惨的痛苦中，仍然喜悦，因为我没有违犯圣者的教训。

text_en: What is my strength, that I should wait? And what is my end, that I should be patient?
text_cn: 我有什么力量使我期待，有什么结局使我拖延生命？

text_en: Is my strength the strength of stones, or is my flesh bronze?
text_cn: 我的力量岂有岩石之坚？我的肉身岂是铜制的？

text_en: In truth I have no help in me, and any resource is driven from me.
text_cn: 在我内还能找到什么作援助？任何扶助岂不都远离了我？

text_en: “Those who withhold kindness from a friend forsake the fear of the Almighty.
text_cn: 谁不怜悯自己的友人，就是放弃了敬畏天主之心。

text_en: My companions are treacherous like a torrent-bed, like freshets that pass away,
text_cn: 我的兄弟们诡诈有如溪水，有如水过即干的河床。

text_en: that run dark with ice, turbid with melting snow.
text_cn: 溪水因结冰而混浊，积雪掩盖在其上；

text_en: In time of heat they disappear; when it is hot, they vanish from their place.
text_cn: 季节一温暖，溪水即竭，天气一炎热，河床即干。

text_en: The caravans turn aside from their course; they go up into the waste, and perish.
text_cn: 商队离开大道，走入荒野，因而丧命。

text_en: The caravans of Tema look, the travelers of Sheba hope.
text_cn: 特玛的商队观望，舍巴的客旅期待，

text_en: They are disappointed because they were confident; they come there and are confounded.
text_cn: 但他们的希望落了空，他们不管到了哪里，必狼狈不堪。

text_en: Such you have now become to me; you see my calamity, and are afraid.
text_cn: 现今你们待我也是一样：看见了我，就惊惶失措。

text_en: Have I said, ‘Make me a gift’? Or, ‘From your wealth offer a bribe for me’?
text_cn: 难道我说过：“请送我礼物！把你们的财产送我一份？

text_en: Or, ‘Save me from an opponent’s hand’? Or, ‘Ransom me from the hand of oppressors’?
text_cn: 救我摆脱仇人的权势，赎我脱离残暴者的掌握？”

text_en: “Teach me, and I will be silent; make me understand how I have gone wrong.
text_cn: 请教训我！我必静听。我有什么错，请指示我！

text_en: How forceful are honest words! But your reproof, what does it reprove?
text_cn: 正义的言词是多么甘美！但你们的责斥是指摘什么？

text_en: Do you think that you can reprove words, as if the speech of the desperate were wind?
text_cn: 你们岂能只在言词上吹毛求疵？以绝望者的话当耳边风？

text_en: You would even cast lots over the orphan, and bargain over your friend.
text_cn: 你们只想对孤儿掷骰下注，以你们的朋友作商品。

text_en: “But now, be pleased to look at me; for I will not lie to your face.
text_cn: 现今请你们注视我，在你们注视之下，我决不说谎。

text_en: Turn, I pray, let no wrong be done. Turn now, my vindication is at stake.
text_cn: 请你们再想一下，不要不公；请你们三思，我的正义仍然存在！

text_en: Is there any wrong on my tongue? Cannot my taste discern calamity?
text_cn: 我的唇舌上岂有不义？我的口腔难道不辨邪正？
